cohort_total_n_excerpt: A total of 452 cases of prostatic cancer identified through the population-based Hawaii Tumor Registry during the period 1977-1983 and 899 age-matched population controls were interviewed on the island of Oahu from 1981 to 1983.
reason: The abstract evaluates dietary factors in relation to prostatic cancer generally. No aggressive prostate cancer endpoint is defined or analyzed.

estimate_classifications.endpoint_excerpt: The corresponding odds ratios were 1.6 (95% CI 1.0-2.5) for carotenes, 1.4 (95% CI 0.9-2.3) for total vitamin C, and 1.7 (95% CI 1.1-2.7) for total zinc.
estimate_classifications.reason: The zinc estimate is reported for prostatic cancer generally, not an aggressive subtype.
